supportingSources.label: Action Pinball Gold Ball Version 12 setup and rules
Video Games November 1983 Gold Ball review

strategy.overview: Gold Ball has two materially different setups. Stock software serves the gold-colored ball at an operator-set random percentage; while that ball is in play, playfield scoring is tripled. Factory Service Kit and compatible Version 12 software can instead require G-O-L-D-B-A-L-L to be completed before the next ball is served as a gold Extra Ball. In either setup, use the right flipper for P-L-A-Y lane change, complete 1-2-3 to advance from 2x to 3x and then its higher award, and follow the lit G-O-L-D-B-A-L-L arrows. During gold-ball play, the flashing upper-right rollover can collect Gold Ball Special according to the installed switch setting.
strategy.simpleOverview: Check the installed ROM first. Stock software serves the gold-colored ball randomly; it triples playfield scoring. Service Kit or Version 12 software makes you complete G-O-L-D-B-A-L-L, then serves the next ball as a gold Extra Ball. Use right-flipper lane change for P-L-A-Y, and complete 1-2-3 for 2x, 3x, then its higher award.
strategy.summary: Identify stock versus skill-earned software before choosing a route. On stock code, build P-L-A-Y, 1-2-3, and letter value until the random gold ball arrives. On skill code, prioritize each lit G-O-L-D-B-A-L-L spot because completing the word guarantees the gold Extra Ball.

quickInfo.name: Check the ROM
quickInfo.summary: Stock is random; Service Kit or Version 12 can make Gold Ball skill-earned.

quickInfo.name: Gold Ball Value
quickInfo.summary: All playfield scoring is tripled while the gold ball is in play.

steps.text: Before play, identify whether the machine uses stock percentage software or skill-earned Service Kit or Version 12 software.
On skill software, hit the currently lit G-O-L-D-B-A-L-L spotting switches until the word is complete; the next served ball is the gold Extra Ball.
While the gold ball is in play, favor controlled repeatable shots because all playfield scores are tripled.
If the upper-right Gold Ball Special rollover flashes, take it before the switch-configured opportunity expires.

alternatives.title: Stock percentage route
alternatives.when: Use this when the machine serves the gold ball randomly rather than through letter completion.

steps.text: Use right-flipper lane change to complete P-L-A-Y and collect its currently lit award.
Complete 1-2-3 for 2x, then 3x, and continue building G-O-L-D-B-A-L-L value while waiting for a gold-ball serve.
When the gold ball appears, switch immediately to the safest repeatable scoring shot for the 3x playfield value.
Reach gold-ball play by the installed random or skill-earned route.
Roll through the upper-right button while Gold Ball Special is flashing; its persistence depends on switch 24.

machineSetup: Record the ROM version and switches 14-16 before play: stock percentage settings serve Gold Ball randomly, while all three OFF enables skill-earned Gold Ball on compatible Service Kit or Version 12 software.

Check switch 24 for whether Gold Ball Special lasts only for the current ball or remains lit until collected, and test the gold-ball gate, P-L-A-Y lanes, 1-2-3 targets, letter spots, left return lane, upper-right rollover, and both trough balls.

cautions.issue: Stock, factory Service Kit, and aftermarket Version 12 rules are not interchangeable.
cautions.response: Do not promise a letter-earned gold ball until the ROM and switches are checked; on stock code the gold ball remains a percentage-based award.
